A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Ov3R work and are readable throughout. Their methods, equations, figures and tables can be matched reliably. Neither supplied PDF contains a separate appendix. The missing runtime table referenced in v3 is a document omission, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: v2 reports original reconstruction, camera-tracking and semantic-segmentation results on Replica, 7Scenes and ScanNetv2, together with component ablations in Tables 1–6.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds baseline comparisons in Tables 1–2 and a standard-CLIP ablation in Table 5.

M1.justification: The stated fusion-weight predictor changes from cross-attention to self-attention after Equation 12, accompanied by a CA-to-SA change in Figure 4. This is a localized architecture revision; the remaining reconstruction branches, descriptor-fusion equations and losses are retained.

E1.justification: Training still uses ScanNet++, Aria Synthetic Environments and CO3D-v2. Evaluation retains Replica, 7Scenes and ScanNetv2, including the same reconstruction, tracking, segmentation and ground-truth-versus-reconstructed geometry conditions. The additional comparisons introduce no new dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: v3 adds StreamVGGT and VGGT-SLAM to both the Replica and 7Scenes reconstruction/tracking comparisons in Tables 1–2. Existing comparator rows remain, and the semantic-segmentation comparator sets in Tables 3–4 are unchanged.

E3.justification: Table 5 adds a controlled condition using standard CLIP instead of object-level CLIP features. Existing benchmark settings, metrics, training budgets and one-in-twenty frame sampling on 7Scenes remain unchanged. The added OVO-protocol attribution clarifies the existing evaluation rather than establishing a revised protocol.

E4.justification: Table 5 adds an ablation directly testing the value of object-level versus standard CLIP features for reconstruction and tracking. Previous CLIP-insertion, CLIP-head, DINO and 3D-encoder ablations remain. The changed row letters in Table 6 are only renumbering.

E5.justification: Neither version reports random seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. v3 retains the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: v3 adds baseline results in Tables 1–2 and standard-CLIP accuracy/completion/RMSE of 3.18/2.20/6.28 in Table 5. Newly included VGGT-SLAM has 7Scenes ATE 6.58 versus Ov3R's retained 7.71. Section 4.5 newly reports approximately 15 FPS for 2D–3D OVS. All matched pre-existing table values remain numerically unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13 retain the same mathematical content, including reconstruction losses, feature-fusion expressions and the similarity objective. Neither version adds or removes formal assumptions, theorems, proofs or derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same RGB-only, two-module framework, semantic–geometric alignment and state-of-the-art reconstruction/segmentation claims. Removing aspirational Spatial-AI and real-time wording does not materially redefine these core contributions.

C2.justification: Section 4.2 newly attributes VGGT-SLAM's tracking advantage on 7Scenes to external SL(4) optimization. New Section 4.5 identifies segmentation as the runtime bottleneck and proposes faster SAM variants for real-time operation. The existing limitation concerning camera-pose accuracy remains.

D1.justification: v3 adds a project-page link and explicitly identifies CLIP3R as the module evaluated in Tables 1–2 and 2D–3D OVS in Tables 3–4. Hardware, backbones, window lengths, the 15-epoch training budget and batch size 512 remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations concerning robotics scene representations, DINO-SLAM, stereo Gaussian-splatting SLAM and Fast Segment Anything. These modestly extend background and runtime positioning; the central distinction from offline and depth-dependent approaches remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized wording cuts and corrections, updates author affiliations, corrects the introduction's '3D-DINO' to '3D-CLIP', and adds a runtime subsection. Most prose and the overall section order remain intact.

P2.justification: Tables 1–2 and 5 gain rows, Tables 1–4 gain module-specific caption clarifications, and several tables are repositioned. Figures 3–4 receive label updates, while figure sizing and the title-block layout are adjusted. The existing six figures and six tables are retained.

improvement.justification: The additional baselines in Tables 1–2 and direct object-level CLIP control in Table 5 strengthen empirical support, while module-specific captions improve clarity. These are limited gains with unchanged central results. The new runtime discussion remains incomplete: it cites 'Table ??' without supplying the promised breakdown, limiting support for its efficiency assessment.
